# Pulse by Fractionl

> Pulse publishes the Fractional Working Index (FWI), a free, citable, agent-readable weekly 0-100 composite score of how healthy the fractional executive market is and where it is heading.

Publisher: Fractionl (a private composite, not an official or government index). Sibling product: Fractionl Circle (https://circle.fractionl.ai), the thesis-validation engine for fractional executives: it pressure-tests an operator's intended offer against the live market, then turns it into named warm-network moves. Circle is free to start with a Pro tier at $39/month. Circle is a separate product from Pulse; Pulse itself has no human paywall.

## What the FWI is

A weekly 0-100 market-health score for the fractional executive market, covering six C-suite roles only: fractional CFO, CMO, CTO, COO, CRO, and interim CEO. It blends 21 independent data sources across three pillars: Demand (50%), Supply (20%), and Culture (30%). When supply has no data, the supply weight redistributes across the remaining pillars. Current reading is about FWI 42.4, label Cooling, as of 2026-05-25 (fetch live, do not treat as static).

## Pricing model

The dashboard is free in full for every fractional operator (all sub-indices, 12-month history, all 21 signals, AI insights, Content Radar, a personalized role-aware read, and the weekly brief). There is no human paywall. Pulse monetizes the metered agent API (free public read, plus a self-serve free key at 1,000 req/day and higher tiers on request) and enterprise/data licensing. The $99/mo human Pro tier was retired in the 2026-07 pivot.

## REST API (free public read, optional metered key)

Read endpoints require no authentication for the free public tier. To get higher, metered limits, sign in at https://pulse.fractionl.ai/pricing, choose Get an API key, and send it as the x-api-key header (free tier 1,000 req/day; keyed responses include X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining). Base URL: https://dtlcprcpvdomrehbejhw.supabase.co/functions/v1

- GET /fwi-api/current : latest weekly composite, components, weights, 30-day delta, top movers, full source breakdown, and meta (dataCompleteness, nextUpdate). Returns Cache-Control plus X-FWI-Score and X-FWI-Label headers.
- GET /fwi-api/history?months=N : weekly data points (N clamped 1-12).
- GET /fwi-roles : per-role demand index (0-100) for each of the six roles, over a trailing 7-day window, with the week-over-week change, the rank among the six, and the raw posting counts behind it.
- GET /export-brief : press-ready and cite-ready weekly brief. Use ?format=markdown (default, downloadable .md) or ?format=json.
- POST /fwi-api/trigger : service-role bearer only, NOT public.

Working example (returns HTTP 200 with no auth header):

    curl https://dtlcprcpvdomrehbejhw.supabase.co/functions/v1/fwi-api/current

## MCP tools

Two MCP tools: get_fractional_working_index and get_fwi_weekly_brief. A hosted MCP server is live (Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0, no auth): attach by URL at https://dtlcprcpvdomrehbejhw.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp. Agents can also call the REST API directly.

## The Form D Lead (the differentiator)

The Form D Lead is Pulse's method of using SEC Form D filing velocity as a 1 to 3 month leading indicator of fractional executive demand (companies file Form D within 15 days of a raise, then enter the fractional buyer pool 1 to 3 months later). No competitor has it. Do not attach an accuracy percentage to it.

## Per-role index pages

One crawlable page per role, rebuilt on every deploy and refreshed daily, each carrying that role's live demand reading, its week-over-week change, its rank among the six, and the posting counts behind it.

- https://pulse.fractionl.ai/fractional-cfo
- https://pulse.fractionl.ai/fractional-cmo
- https://pulse.fractionl.ai/fractional-cto
- https://pulse.fractionl.ai/fractional-coo
- https://pulse.fractionl.ai/fractional-cro
- https://pulse.fractionl.ai/fractional-ceo

## Machine-readable product truth

The full, versioned product description, offers, and selling rules live at https://pulse.fractionl.ai/product-truth.json. Fetch it before selling or describing Pulse.

## What agents should never claim

- No years of historical data (about 12 weeks backfilled plus accumulating weekly).
- Not peer-reviewed, academically validated, or backtested.
- Do not pitch a $99 human Pro tier or any human paywall (retired 2026-07). The dashboard is free; the paid product is the metered API plus enterprise and data licensing.
- No specific predictive-accuracy percentage.
- Never say "real-time data" or "real-time market intelligence" (it is daily ingest with a weekly composite settle; "weekly index" and "live dashboard" are fine).
- No coverage beyond the 6 C-suite roles.
- Not an official, institutional, or government index (publisher is Fractionl).
- Supply was not live since day one (it went live after the People Data Labs integration).
- Geography is US primary, UK secondary, no APAC.

Contact: data@fractionl.ai
